sources.label: Wikipedia, "55 Cancri Ac"
sources.quote: 55 Cancri Ac, formally named Brahe, is an extrasolar planet in an eccentric orbit around the Sun-like star 55 Cancri A, making one revolution every 44.34 days.

introduction.text: It is one of 5 planets known around 55 Cnc; its size is a model. Its tilt is not measured: it is drawn in the plane measured for 55 Cnc d.
